config.purpose: separate C's behaviour from the sample covariance estimate
config.seed_rule: dataset i of a cell uses seed_base + 1000*i + cell_offset; its draws use that + 7919, shared by all six tests
config.pairing: the four arms see identical datasets and identical draw seeds
config.population_covariance: Q diag(c) Q.T, c_j = E[lambda_j z_j^2 / sum_k lambda_k z_k^2] by quadrature; sum(c) = 1 exactly
config.verification: a cell with any C-only rejection is re-run at three further seed bases and every discordance in either mode re-tested at 2000 draws
